body.name: Rademacher predictable-variation handle
body.construction: Expose the additive schedules under \(\mathbb H_n^{\mathrm{same}}\) and \(\mathbb H_n^{\mathrm{ind}}\) through \(\mathcal F_{n,r}\); compute conditional second moments from the remaining unit signs, unfinished \(M\)-slots, and remaining treatment-label counts, control the variance of \(Q_n/\sigma_n^2\) by bounded differences, and diagonalize high-probability prior rows.
